thesis: Build a living world as a synchronized, evidence-bearing habitat: substrate, entities, traces, uncertainty, and camera all remain legible as different layers.
non_negotiables: World substrate and live semantic entities are visually distinct.
Verified, provisional, unresolved, stale, and uncertain states are material behaviors, not color labels only.
Stigmergic coordination persists in the environment; moving workers alone are insufficient.
Camera is an event-conditioned visibility system, not a decorative orbit.
Scale is a navigation state with overview/detail continuity.
Geometry grows hierarchically from semantic parents and never invents canonical facts.
Every visible transformation retains provenance and uncertainty attribution.
Reduced motion is an explicit readable mode, not a hidden fallback.

principles: macro terrain first; local detail inherits boundaries
world silhouette and horizon establish scale
small selected state tuple drives motifs
route filaments are causal, not decoration
aggregate uncertainty first; attribution on demand

implementation_order: P0 fix runtime shader/CORS/React blockers (done and Playwright-verified)
P1 replace flat terrain with macro substrate + sparse local detail + horizon scale
P3 make traces persistent and causal; animate only changes, not perpetual noise
P4 add event-conditioned camera targets and overview/detail navigation
P5 grow architecture from semantic parents with collision/containment invariants
P6 add uncertainty/provenance and reduced-motion QA
P7 capture real v21 runtime and build film from the same event timeline
acceptance_gates: outsider can name substrate, worker, trace, and receipt in under 30 seconds
camera can show target without occlusion at three scales
a state change alters material/trace according to source evidence
no visual object exists without a source id or explicit art-direction role
Playwright screenshot has canvas=1, page errors=0, relay snapshot and SSE CORS pass
